verdict.rationale: Galileo's own docs show LangChain and LangGraph apps being traced into Galileo, including a LangGraph path via OpenTelemetry and OpenInference, and claim compatibility with major LLM providers and agentic frameworks. The evidence does not show a dedicated OpenAI SDK wrapper or any Vercel AI SDK integration, so the story is only about half covered. Missing for 10: a documented OpenAI SDK integration (the quickstart only says it works with OpenAI), a Vercel AI SDK integration, a framework integration catalog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: A simple LangChain-powered AI Agent that uses OpenAI's language models and a custom tool, with all agent activities logged and monitored in Galileo.
Learn how to instrument a LangGraph agent with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to capture detailed traces, spans, and metrics.
Galileo works with all major LLM providers and can be used with your favorite agentic framework
This guide works with Python or TypeScript, using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI service, Anthropic, or Gemini LLMs.
